```{r}
install.packages("jsonlite")
library(jsonlite)

THRESHOLD <- 0.05
ALPHA <- 0.05
MODELS_DIR <- file.path("..", "models")
MODEL_FILES <- c(
  "Llama 3"  = "Llama-3-70B-Instruct_RESULTS.zip",
  "Mixtral"  = "mixtral8x7b-Instruct-v0.1_RESULTS.zip",
  "Qwen"     = "qwen3.5-27b_RESULTS.zip",
  "DeepSeek" = "deepseek-r1-7b_RESULTS.zip"
)
STRATEGIES <- c(simple = "Simple", instruct = "Detail", fewshot = "1-shot")
DATASETS <- c("TREC", "CB", "RTE", "DBPedia", "WoS")
```

```{r}
identify_dataset <- function(path) {
  path <- tolower(path)
  parts <- strsplit(path, "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if ("cb-train" %in% parts) return("CB")
  folder_names <- c(DBPedia = "dbpedia", RTE = "rte", TREC = "trec", WoS = "wos")
  for (name in names(folder_names)) if (folder_names[[name]] %in% parts) return(name)
  keys <- list(c("DBPedia", "dbpedia_results"), c("TREC", "trec_results"), c("RTE", "rte_results"),
               c("WoS", "wos_results"), c("WoS", "wos46985_results"), c("CB", "cb_results"))
  for (k in keys) if (grepl(k[2], path, fixed = TRUE)) return(k[1])
  NA_character_
}
```


```{r}
sensitivity_of <- function(dists) {
  mean(vapply(dists, function(p) {
    nz <- p[p > 0]
    -sum(nz * log(nz)) / log(length(p))
  }, numeric(1)))
}

consistency_of <- function(dists, targets) {
  total <- 0
  pairs <- 0
  for (target in unique(targets)) {
    P <- do.call(rbind, dists[targets == target])  
    tvd <- matrix(0, nrow(P), nrow(P))
    for (k in seq_len(ncol(P))) tvd <- tvd + abs(outer(P[, k], P[, k], "-"))
    tvd <- tvd / 2
    total <- total + sum(1 - tvd)
    pairs <- pairs + nrow(P)^2
  }
  total / pairs
}

our_configurations <- function() {
  rows <- list()
  tmp <- tempfile("yd_results_")
  for (model in names(MODEL_FILES)) {
    zip_path <- file.path(MODELS_DIR, MODEL_FILES[[model]])
    if (!file.exists(zip_path)) stop("Missing file: ", zip_path,
                                     ". Set the working directory to the 'correlation' folder.")
    for (path in unzip(zip_path, list = TRUE)$Name) {
      dataset <- identify_dataset(path)
      strategy <- NA_character_
      for (k in names(STRATEGIES)) if (endsWith(path, paste0("results_", k, ".json"))) strategy <- STRATEGIES[[k]]
      lower <- tolower(path)
     
      if (is.na(dataset) || is.na(strategy) || grepl("smoke", lower, fixed = TRUE) ||
          grepl("test_labeled", lower, fixed = TRUE)) next
      unzip(zip_path, files = path, exdir = tmp)
      data <- read_json(file.path(tmp, path), simplifyVector = FALSE)
      samples <- Filter(function(s) is.list(s) && !is.null(s$distribution), data)
      dists <- lapply(samples, function(s) as.numeric(unlist(s$distribution)))
      targets <- vapply(samples, function(s) as.character(s$target), character(1))
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        model = model, dataset = dataset, strategy = strategy,
        sensitivity = sensitivity_of(dists), consistency = consistency_of(dists, targets))
      cat("read", model, dataset, strategy, "\n")
    }
  }
  unlink(tmp, recursive = TRUE)
  df <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  if (any(duplicated(df[, c("model", "dataset", "strategy")]))) stop("duplicate configuration")
  df
}
paper_configurations <- function() {
  rows <- list()
  for (model in names(PAPER)) {
    m <- PAPER[[model]]
    for (i in seq_along(DATASETS)) {
      for (j in seq_along(STRATEGIES)) {
        rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          model = model, dataset = DATASETS[i], strategy = STRATEGIES[[j]],
          sensitivity = m[i, 2 * j - 1], consistency = m[i, 2 * j])
      }
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
```

the statistics results are here:
```{r}

pearson <- function(df) {
  n <- nrow(df)
  if (n < 4 || length(unique(df$sensitivity)) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(n = n, r = NA, p = NA, ci_low = NA, ci_high = NA))
  }
  test <- cor.test(df$sensitivity, df$consistency, method = "pearson")
  r <- unname(test$estimate)
  se <- 1 / sqrt(n - 3)
  z <- atanh(r)
  data.frame(n = n, r = r, p = test$p.value, ci_low = tanh(z - 1.96 * se), ci_high = tanh(z + 1.96 * se))
}

fisher_difference <- function(r1, n1, r2, n2) {
  z <- (atanh(r1) - atanh(r2)) / sqrt(1 / (n1 - 3) + 1 / (n2 - 3))
  c(z = z, p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z)))
}

power_difference <- function(rho1, rho2, n1, n2, alpha = ALPHA) {
  delta <- abs(atanh(rho1) - atanh(rho2))
  se <- sqrt(1 / (n1 - 3) + 1 / (n2 - 3))
  crit <- qnorm(1 - alpha / 2)
  pnorm(delta / se - crit) + pnorm(-delta / se - crit)
}
demeaned <- function(df, by) {
  key <- interaction(df[by], drop = TRUE)
  df$sensitivity <- df$sensitivity - ave(df$sensitivity, key)
  df$consistency <- df$consistency - ave(df$consistency, key)
  df
}

show <- function(title, df) {
  cat("\n##", title, "\n\n")
  num <- vapply(df, is.numeric, logical(1))
  df[num] <- lapply(df[num], function(x) round(x, 4))
  print(df, row.names = FALSE)
}

#from the main
ours_all <- our_configurations()
paper_all <- paper_configurations()
ours <- ours_all[ours_all$sensitivity >= THRESHOLD, ]
paper <- paper_all[paper_all$sensitivity >= THRESHOLD, ]
cat("\nOur configurations:", nrow(ours_all), "- with S >=", THRESHOLD, ":", nrow(ours), "\n")
cat("Paper configurations:", nrow(paper_all), "- with S >=", THRESHOLD, ":", nrow(paper), "\n")

#corr. with CI
groups <- list(
  list("Mixtral", "Mixtral", c("ours", "paper")),
  list("Llama 3", "Llama 3", c("ours", "paper")),
  list("Mixtral + Llama 3", c("Mixtral", "Llama 3"), c("ours", "paper")),
  list("Qwen", "Qwen", "ours"),
  list("DeepSeek", "DeepSeek", "ours"),
  list("GPT-3.5", "GPT-3.5", "paper"),
  list("GPT-4o", "GPT-4o", "paper"),
  list("All four (ours: Mixtral, Llama 3, Qwen, DeepSeek)", names(MODEL_FILES), "ours"),
  list("All four (paper: Mixtral, Llama 3, GPT-3.5, GPT-4o)", names(PAPER), "paper"))
rows <- list()
for (g in groups) {
  for (source in g[[3]]) {
    data <- if (source == "ours") ours else paper
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- cbind(group = g[[1]], source = source,
                                      pearson(data[data$model %in% g[[2]], ]))
  }
}
show("1.Pearson r per group (S >= 0.05), 95% CI from the Fisher z-transform", do.call(rbind, rows))

```

difference ours vs. paper:
```{r}
rows <- list()
for (g in list(list("Mixtral", "Mixtral"), list("Llama 3", "Llama 3"),
               list("Mixtral + Llama 3", c("Mixtral", "Llama 3")))) {
  a <- pearson(ours[ours$model %in% g[[2]], ])
  b <- pearson(paper[paper$model %in% g[[2]], ])
  f <- fisher_difference(a$r, a$n, b$r, b$n)
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(group = g[[1]], r_ours = a$r, n_ours = a$n,
                                         r_paper = b$r, n_paper = b$n, z = f[["z"]], p_difference = f[["p"]])
}
show("2.Is our r different from the paper's r for the same models? (Fisher z-test)", do.call(rbind, rows))
```


```{r}
# Power
a <- pearson(ours[ours$model %in% c("Mixtral", "Llama 3"), ])
b <- pearson(paper[paper$model %in% c("Mixtral", "Llama 3"), ])
n80 <- 5
while (power_difference(-0.44, -0.07, n80, n80) < 0.8) n80 <- n80 + 1
show("3. Power of the Fisher z-test (alpha = 0.05, two-sided)", data.frame(
  comparison = c("our r vs the paper's reported -0.07", "-0.44 vs -0.07 (same as above, rounded)",
                 "-0.44 vs 0 (no correlation)", "n per group needed for 80% power, -0.44 vs -0.07"),
  n1 = c(a$n, a$n, a$n, n80), n2 = c(b$n, b$n, b$n, NA),
  power = c(power_difference(a$r, -0.07, a$n, b$n), power_difference(-0.44, -0.07, a$n, b$n),
            power_difference(-0.44, 0, a$n, b$n), 0.8)))

#pooled vs within-group correlations
rows <- list()
for (g in list(list("paper", names(PAPER)), list("paper", c("Mixtral", "Llama 3")),
               list("ours", c("Mixtral", "Llama 3")), list("ours", names(MODEL_FILES)))) {
  data <- if (g[[1]] == "ours") ours else paper
  sub <- data[data$model %in% g[[2]], ]
  within_ds <- pearson(demeaned(sub, "dataset"))
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(source = g[[1]], models = paste(g[[2]], collapse = " + "),
                                         pooled_r = pearson(sub)$r,
                                         within_model_r = pearson(demeaned(sub, "model"))$r,
                                         within_dataset_r = within_ds$r, within_dataset_p = within_ds$p)
}
show("4.Pooled vs within-group correlations (group means removed)", do.call(rbind, rows))
```
